paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Astrophysical bound from R parameter (HB/RGB star ratio) in 39 Galactic Globular Clusters. Main result g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, valid for axion mass below a few keV (Primakoff production in stellar cores). Encoded as mass-independent horizontal line spanning the stated validity range up to ~10 keV.
